immutable_stage4_1_rule.description: Stage-4.2A is append-only downstream evidence. It hash-links the complete Stage-4.1 authority, report, receipt, and verification tuple and cannot rewrite their values, gates, or claim ceiling.

source_authorities.citation: S. Sturm et al., High-precision measurement of the atomic mass of the electron, Nature 506, 467-470 (2014).
source_authorities.supports: The Penning-trap bound-electron frequency-ratio method and published electron relative atomic-mass inference.
source_authorities.does_not_support: Static weighing, an adjustment-independent CODATA confirmation, Higgs identification, or a collapse mechanism.

source_authorities.citation: F. Koehler et al., The electron mass from g-factor measurements on hydrogen-like carbon 12C5+.
source_authorities.supports: The detailed correction, line-shape, bound-g, and supersession history required for a diagnostic metrology replay.
source_authorities.does_not_support: A source-independent electron-mass measurement or any Casimir, DP, manifold, or quantum-foam connection.

source_authorities.citation: P. J. Mohr et al., CODATA recommended values of the fundamental physical constants: 2022.
source_authorities.supports: Adjusted electron-mass, Fermi-constant, uncertainty, correlation, and SI conversion context.
source_authorities.does_not_support: Independent confirmation between quantities sharing the same least-squares adjustment.

source_authorities.citation: BIPM SI Brochure and defining constants.
source_authorities.supports: Exact SI values and unit semantics for h, c, e, and k_B.
source_authorities.does_not_support: A physical bridge between rest energy, blackbody radiation, and collapse.

source_authorities.citation: Particle Data Group, Status of Higgs Boson Physics, Review of Particle Physics (2025).
source_authorities.supports: The Standard Model tree-level Yukawa convention and the distinction between inferred and directly measured couplings.
source_authorities.does_not_support: Why the electron Yukawa has its value or a Higgs-to-Casimir/DP transfer.

source_authorities.citation: CMS Collaboration, Search for the Higgs boson decay to a pair of electrons, Phys. Lett. B 846, 137783 (2023).
source_authorities.supports: The direct H to e+e- branching-fraction upper limit at 95 percent confidence.
source_authorities.does_not_support: An observation of the Standard Model electron Yukawa coupling.

source_authorities.citation: IAU 2015 Resolution B3 on recommended nominal conversion constants for selected solar and planetary properties.
source_authorities.supports: Nominal solar radius, luminosity, and flux-equivalent effective-temperature conversion constants.
source_authorities.does_not_support: A spectrum-only solar temperature, a true time-invariant solar property, or stellar-structure validation.

source_authorities.citation: TSIS-1 Hybrid Solar Reference Spectrum, LASP Interactive Solar Irradiance Datacenter.
source_authorities.supports: A source-backed solar spectral-irradiance snapshot for a band-dependent diagnostic color-temperature recovery.
source_authorities.does_not_support: A perfect-blackbody Sun, equality of color and bolometric effective temperature, or an independent DP test.

cross_scale_calibration_ladder: Penning frequency ratios and bound-state QED infer the electron rest-mass anchor.
E=m_ec^2, E=h nu, and the Stage-4.1 QED identities transform that anchor into correlated energy, frequency, and atomic scales.
Planck radiance and its Stefan-Boltzmann integral reuse h, c, and k_B to calibrate radiometric energy-frequency bookkeeping.
A TSIS spectral peak yields a band/model-dependent color temperature, while IAU luminosity and radius define a distinct bolometric effective temperature.
Only a preregistered residual following a frozen E_G/hbar law after ordinary-physics closure can test a named DP model.
scientific_boundaries: The calibration ladder is a dependency and unit-consistency ladder, not cumulative evidence for DP.
Electron kg, joule, MeV, Compton-frequency, and Rydberg forms are correlated transforms and cannot be vote-counted.
The Standard Model tree relation rewrites the measured mass in Yukawa notation; it does not independently predict the electron mass.
The Planck integral and Stefan-Boltzmann constant are one radiometric identity family, not two independent tests.
Solar color temperature and bolometric effective temperature are operationally different observables and may differ without contradiction.

Cosmological collapse, inflationary corrections, dark-energy backreaction, Planck-scale discreteness, and manifold dynamics remain conditional future theories with no registered laboratory-to-cosmology kernel.
No common constant, unit, dimensionality, frequency, scale hierarchy, or use of the word vacuum opens an observable bridge to Casimir, DP, collapse, or manifolds.
